integration_audit_summary.scope: External protocol integrations and trust boundaries

fee_on_transfer_handling.description: Protocol correctly handles fee-on-transfer tokens in fundProject function by measuring actual received amount
fee_on_transfer_handling.risk_assessment: Fee-on-transfer tokens are properly accounted for in project funding

rebasing_token_assumption.description: Protocol assumes reward tokens are not rebasing. Rebasing tokens could break reward calculations and escrow accounting
rebasing_token_assumption.impact: Rebasing tokens would cause reward calculations to drift from intended values, potentially underpaying or overpaying participants
rebasing_token_assumption.recommendation: Add explicit checks for token rebasing behavior or document as unsupported

blacklist_token_risks.description: Protocol uses SafeERC20 but doesn't validate token behavior beyond basic transfer safety
blacklist_token_risks.impact: Blacklisted addresses could be unable to participate, causing protocol failures
blacklist_token_risks.recommendation: Document token behavior requirements and consider allowlist for supported tokens

safeerc20_usage.description: All ERC20 transfers use SafeERC20 wrapper, providing basic protection against non-standard implementations

unused_pluggable_interface.description: ConsensusAlgorithm address is stored but ConsensusLib.calculate() is called directly instead of via pluggable interface
unused_pluggable_interface.impact: Pluggable consensus feature exists in storage but is non-functional, limiting upgrade flexibility
unused_pluggable_interface.exploit_scenario: Future upgrade attempts to use pluggable consensus would fail silently
unused_pluggable_interface.recommendation: Either implement pluggable consensus calls or remove dead storage

delegatecall_trust_boundary.description: ConsensusLib operates via delegatecall and assumes correct storage access patterns
delegatecall_trust_boundary.impact: Storage collision or incorrect delegatecall could corrupt consensus calculations
delegatecall_trust_boundary.recommendation: Add runtime checks for storage integrity in consensus operations

arbitrary_logic_execution.description: Adapter contracts can implement arbitrary logic in transferFrom calls, allowing censorship or manipulation
arbitrary_logic_execution.impact: Malicious adapters could selectively fail transfers or manipulate token flows
arbitrary_logic_execution.exploit_scenario: Adapter checks msg.sender and fails transfers for specific users, enabling censorship
arbitrary_logic_execution.recommendation: Implement adapter allowlist with security reviews or remove adapter abstraction

fee_collection_discrepancy.description: Adapter fees are credited to pendingRewards but not always deducted from escrow, causing phantom balance issues
fee_collection_discrepancy.impact: Escrow accounting becomes inconsistent, potentially leading to over-distribution
fee_collection_discrepancy.recommendation: Fix escrow deduction logic for all adapter fee types

validation_adapter_dead_code.description: validationAdapter mapping exists but is never populated, making validation fees impossible to charge
validation_adapter_dead_code.impact: Incomplete feature implementation creates confusion and potential future bugs
validation_adapter_dead_code.recommendation: Remove validation adapter feature or implement it properly

share_transfer_bypass.description: StakeVault inherits ERC4626 but has incomplete _update override that may not fully prevent share transfers bypassing locks
share_transfer_bypass.impact: Users could transfer locked shares to bypass stake requirements, breaking economic security
share_transfer_bypass.exploit_scenario: User with locked stake transfers ERC4626 shares to new address and redeems, circumventing locks
share_transfer_bypass.recommendation: Complete _update override to fully prevent unauthorized share transfers

inflation_attack_mitigation.effectiveness: Reduces share precision to prevent dust attacks

pausable_inheritance_gap.description: ERC4626 inherited deposit/withdraw functions not subject to pause modifier
pausable_inheritance_gap.impact: Emergency pause may not fully halt vault operations
pausable_inheritance_gap.recommendation: Override deposit/withdraw functions to add pause checks if needed

bundler_censorship_assumption.description: Protocol assumes ERC-4337 bundler doesn't inspect or modify signed UserOperations
bundler_censorship_assumption.impact: Malicious bundler could censor or manipulate user operations

paymaster_sponsorship_trust.description: Protocol assumes paymaster correctly sponsors gas and enforces rate limits
paymaster_sponsorship_trust.impact: Paymaster failure could prevent user operations from executing
paymaster_sponsorship_trust.recommendation: Implement paymaster health checks and fallback mechanisms

smart_account_security_assumption.description: Protocol assumes Coinbase Smart Wallet provides secure delegation and recovery
smart_account_security_assumption.impact: Smart account compromise could lead to protocol fund loss
smart_account_security_assumption.recommendation: Implement account verification and recovery monitoring

entrypoint_infrastructure_trust.description: Protocol assumes ERC-4337 EntryPoint operates correctly and doesn't censor
entrypoint_infrastructure_trust.impact: EntryPoint failure affects all protocol operations
entrypoint_infrastructure_trust.recommendation: Monitor EntryPoint status and implement contingency plans

cross_chain_replay_risks.description: Protocol uses block.timestamp for deadlines but doesn't account for cross-chain timing differences
cross_chain_replay_risks.impact: Timing-based operations could behave unexpectedly on different chains

gas_price_volatility.description: ERC-4337 paymaster sponsorship assumes stable gas economics
gas_price_volatility.impact: High gas prices could make paymaster uneconomical

consensus_calculation_overflow.description: ConsensusLib performs stake * weight * PRECISION multiplication without explicit overflow checks
consensus_calculation_overflow.impact: Large stake amounts could cause uint256 overflow in consensus calculations
consensus_calculation_overflow.recommendation: Add SafeMath operations or validate input bounds

adapter_fee_arithmetic_overflow.description: Adapter fee calculations use unchecked arithmetic
adapter_fee_arithmetic_overflow.impact: Extreme fee configurations could cause unexpected behavior
adapter_fee_arithmetic_overflow.recommendation: Add bounds checking for fee parameters

decentralization_concerns.centralized_admin_control: Single admin controls critical parameters and consensus algorithm
decentralization_concerns.bundler_dependency: Protocol dependent on specific ERC-4337 bundler operations
decentralization_concerns.paymaster_single_point_failure: Single paymaster could become bottleneck or failure point

immediate_actions: Complete ERC4626 _update override to prevent share transfer bypass
Fix adapter fee escrow accounting discrepancies
Implement or remove dead consensus algorithm code
short_term_mitigations: Add adapter contract allowlist with security reviews
Implement runtime checks for consensus calculation integrity
long_term_improvements: Add paymaster health checks and fallback mechanisms
documentation_updates: Clearly document all external protocol assumptions
Specify supported token types and behaviors
